clusters.pattern_name: Python virtualenv error diagnosis and repair
clusters.description: Diagnose and fix Python environment/path/dependency/virtualenv errors by reproducing the error, verifying the virtualenv setup, then repairing and validating the fix.
clusters.similarity_reason: All four tasks share identical final_steps (reproduce error, confirm virtualenv, fix and verify) and all target Python environment-related failures, differing only in the specific symptom (env, path, dependency, virtualenv).
clusters.reusable_value: This is a repeatable multi-step debugging workflow for Python environment issues. It can be codified as a standard procedure to quickly isolate virtualenv misconfigurations, reduce debugging time, and ensure consistent verification across similar future incidents.

distillations.cluster_name: Python virtualenv error diagnosis and repair
distillations.reason: The four tasks all follow the same stable workflow: reproduce the error, confirm the virtualenv is active, then fix and verify. This is the same task family as the existing 'debug-python' skill (Python error diagnosis). The existing skill body is minimal (reproduce, read traceback, fix and verify) and does not explicitly cover the virtualenv confirmation step that all four tasks added. Since multiple completed tasks consistently validate this new step, it naturally extends the existing skill rather than forming a new family.
